gatherResult.detail: gather emitted a non-fatal WARNING ('fetched 2 stakers but stakerCount returned 3') and wrote count=2/5, dropping the last staker of each pool: 0x25AdA296F30976024d675Cd219f9aAF1F2Ad4eb1 (DOLA, index 2) and 0x0f254C40729C93093DC0D290E716B842a9C4484a (USDC, index 5). Root cause: getStakersRange is half-open [start,end); the JS loop passes Math.min(start+PAGE,count)-1 as the EXCLUSIVE end arg, so the final element is never read.
